create_phrase_structure_sentence: create a PhraseStructureSentence from a constituency parse tree string like '(S (NP The cat) (VP meows))'
build_tagged_sentence: build a TaggedSentence from word-tag pairs with a vocabulary dictionary and unkifier
run_dfs_traverse: run depth-first traversal on a phrase structure tree to yield NT, PRETERM, TERM, and REDUCE symbols
run_lc_traverse: run left-corner traversal on a phrase structure tree to yield symbols in left-corner order
convert_to_choe_charniak: convert a constituency parse tree to Choe & Charniak bracketed string format
